methodologyNotes: This dataset covers 12 widely-searched water filter pitcher and dispenser models spanning budget, mid-range, and premium tiers. Sources consulted include manufacturer product pages (brita.com, pur.com, zerowater.com, lifestraw.com, epicwaterfilters.com, clearlyfiltered.com, drinkaquagear.com, waterdropfilter.com), major retailer listings (Amazon, Walmart, Home Depot, Best Buy, Culligan), and independent review sites. Capacity is reported in US cups; filter_life_gallons reflects the manufacturer's current rated gallons per filter cartridge under standard laboratory conditions (ZeroWater life varies widely by source TDS; current ZeroWater 5-stage filters are rated ~20 gallons at standard TDS). certification_nsf lists the NSF/ANSI standards the product or its filter is formally certified or independently tested against; certifications were re-verified against each brand's own product page on 2026-06-19. filters_lead is true only where the manufacturer or a third-party test documents lead reduction. replacement_filter_cost is the single-filter USD price from the brand's own store or a primary US retailer. Prices independently re-verified 2026-06-19: ZeroWater 10-cup corrected 49->37.99 (zerowater.com/Walmart); PUR PLUS corrected 28.99->26.96 (Walmart, no firm MSRP); ZeroWater filter life corrected 15->20 gal to match current manufacturer rating. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Brita Tahoe 10-Cup Pitcher with Original Filter
products.provenance: Price $36.99 confirmed on brita.com product listing (corroborated via Target/Lowes/Home Depot listings, 2026-06-19). Original (Standard) filter rated 40 gallons / 2 months and certified NSF/ANSI 42 (chlorine, taste, odor) only; does not carry NSF/ANSI 53 lead certification per brita.com. Replacement filter price ~$7.99 per brita.com Original Replacement Filters.

products.name: Brita Tahoe 10-Cup Pitcher with Elite Filter
products.provenance: Price $41.99 and 120-gallon / 6-month Elite filter life confirmed on brita.com (corroborated via Amazon/Home Depot listings, 2026-06-19). Elite filter certified NSF/ANSI 42, 53, 401; removes 99% of lead per brita.com. Replacement Elite filter single-pack ~$19.99.

products.provenance: Filter-as-you-pour design, 10-cup capacity, 40-gallon / 2-month Stream filter confirmed via brita.com product page and multiple retailer listings (2026-06-19). products.name: Brita UltraMax Water Dispenser 27-Cup with Elite Filter
products.provenance: Price $49.99 and 27-cup capacity confirmed on brita.com (corroborated via Amazon listing, NSF certified to remove 99% of lead, 2026-06-19). products.name: PUR PLUS 7-Cup Water Filter Pitcher
products.priceNote: No single published MSRP; observed Walmart retail $21.74-$26.96; $26.96 used as documented retail
products.provenance: Capacity 7 cups, filter life 40 gallons / 2 months confirmed on pur.com (2026-06-19). PUR PLUS filter (PPF951K) is WQA certified to reduce lead and NSF certified to reduce microplastics per pur.com; filter is NSF/ANSI 42 and 53 certified. Price corrected 28.99->26.96: no single published MSRP exists; observed Walmart range $21.74-$26.96, so $26.96 used as a documented retail price (the prior $28.99 was above any verified retailer price). Replacement filter PPF951K1 single-pack ~$7.99.

products.name: ZeroWater 10-Cup Ready-Pour 5-Stage Pitcher
products.provenance: Price corrected 49->37.99: zerowater.com lists $37.99 and Walmart shows $36.99 (was $45); the prior $49 exceeded all verified retail. TDS meter included confirmed. IAPMO certified to reduce lead, chromium, PFOA/PFOS; independently NSF-certified to NSF/ANSI 42 (chlorine taste/odor) and 53 (lead, chromium, mercury) per ZeroWater/retailer listings. NSF 401 certification not corroborated on the product page, so certification_nsf narrowed to '42, 53' (was '42, 53, 401'). Filter life corrected 15->20 gallons to match current ZeroWater rating; real-world life varies by source TDS. Replacement 2-pack $34.99 (~$17.50/filter) per zerowater.com. 80 oz (10 cups) capacity confirmed. Source URL changed to the live Walmart/Culligan listing (draft's shop.culligan.com page did not display a price).

products.name: ZeroWater 22-Cup Ready-Read 5-Stage Dispenser
products.provenance: 22-cup capacity, 5-stage filter, built-in TDS meter (Ready-Read instant TDS display) and IAPMO certification confirmed via Amazon product title and Best Buy listing (SKU 6582202 verified live, 2026-06-19). IAPMO certified to reduce lead, chromium, PFOA/PFOS; independently NSF-certified to NSF/ANSI 42 and 53. NSF 401 not corroborated, so certification_nsf narrowed to '42, 53'. Same 5-stage filter as 10-cup model, so 20-gallon current rating and $17.50/filter replacement apply. MSRP not publicly confirmed; set to null.

products.name: LifeStraw Home 7-Cup Plastic Water Filter Pitcher
products.provenance: Price $44.95, 7-cup capacity, membrane microfilter life 264 gallons / ~1 year, NSF/ANSI 42, 53, 401, P473 standards, and lead/heavy-metal removal all confirmed on lifestraw.com (2026-06-19). The 264-gallon life refers to the membrane microfilter (annual); the carbon + ion-exchange stage requires replacement every 40 gallons / ~2 months. Membrane replacement single $24.95 confirmed on lifestraw.com.

products.name: Aquagear Water Filter Pitcher
products.provenance: Price $69.95, 10-cup / 80 oz capacity, and 120-gallon filter life confirmed on drinkaquagear.com and Amazon listing (2026-06-19). Third-party tested to NSF 42, 53, 401, P473 standards via accredited labs per product descriptions, but no formal NSF certification documented on the brand page; certification_nsf set to null. Lead reduction 98.4% documented on product page. Replacement single pitcher filter $49.95 confirmed on drinkaquagear.com/products/pitcher-filter.

products.name: Clearly Filtered Water Pitcher
products.priceNote: MSRP $100 per clearlyfiltered.com; sale price $90 observed
products.provenance: MSRP $100 and sale price $90 confirmed on clearlyfiltered.com (2026-06-19). Lower filtered reservoir 80 oz (~10 cups). Filter life 100 gallons confirmed. Pitcher formally NSF certified to NSF/ANSI 42 and 372; filters independently tested to NSF/ANSI 42, 53, 401, 473 (not formally NSF 53 certified). Lead removal ~99%+ per third-party performance data. Replacement single filter MSRP $55 confirmed. Corroboration URL changed to live Amazon listing (draft's bos-water.com review URL not verifiable).

products.name: Epic Pure Water Filter Pitcher
products.provenance: Price $84.00, 10-cup capacity (2.5L lower reservoir), and 150-gallon filter life confirmed on epicwaterfilters.com and Amazon listing (2026-06-19). Lead removal 99.94% per epicwaterfilters.com. Independently tested/verified to NSF/ANSI 42, 53, 401, P473 by certified labs; not formally NSF-certified under all standards. Replacement single filter $53 confirmed on epicwaterfilters.com. Corroboration URL changed to live Amazon listing (draft's qualitywaterlab.com review URL not verifiable).

products.name: Waterdrop Chubby 10-Cup Water Filter Pitcher
products.provenance: Price $27.49, 10-cup capacity, and filter life up to 200 gallons / 3 months confirmed on waterdropfilter.com (2026-06-19). NSF 42 (chlorine, taste, odor) and NSF 372 (lead-free materials) certified per product page. NSF 372 certifies materials are lead-free but does not certify lead reduction in water; lead filtration performance is not explicitly claimed and not documented in third-party tests reviewed; filters_lead set to null. Replacement filter 3-pack ~$41.99 (~$14/filter). Corroboration URL updated; draft's shouldit.com review not verifiable.
